//==
// ## UV layout bookkeeping

// The undirected mesh edges across which UV coordinates are discontinuous:
// texture seams. Pairs are canonical (A.Value <= B.Value).
type UvSeam
    implements IValue
{
    UndirectedEdges: Array<VertexPair>;
}

// A connected set of faces that maps to one contiguous region of UV space
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UV_mapping). UvBounds is that region,
// expressed in UV space via Bounds2D (X = U, Y = V).
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - UV origin (origin top-left, U right, V down).
type UvChart
    implements IValue
{
    Faces: Array<FaceIndex>;
    UvBounds: Bounds2D;
}

// A complete UV layout (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texture_atlas): charts
// packed into the unit UV square at the texel resolution AtlasSize, the seams
// the unwrap introduced, and the padding (in texels) kept between charts to
// avoid bleeding.
type UvAtlas
    implements IValue
{
    Charts: Array<UvChart>;
    Seams: UvSeam;
    AtlasSize: IntegerSize2D;
    PaddingTexels: Integer;
}

//==
// ## Deformation-support channels
//
// Blend shapes (morph targets) live with skeletal animation as MorphTarget
// (`skeletal-animation.types.plato`); this section holds the mesh-side selection channels.

// A named weighted subset of vertices: soft selections, deformer influence
// regions, pinning masks. Vertices and Weights are parallel arrays; weights
// lie in [0, 1]; vertices not listed have weight 0.
type VertexGroup
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Vertices: Array<VertexIndex>;
    Weights: Array<Number>;
}

//==
// # Unwelded face arrays
//
// Faces stored whole, with no index table and no vertex sharing: the form that
// comes out of CSG, marching cubes, tessellation, and STL import before a weld
// pass. The indexed counterparts are `TriangleMesh3D` / `QuadMesh3D`
// (declared above); representing unwelded geometry as one of those would need a
// 3n-entry identity index array, which wastes storage and falsely claims
// sharing.
//
// `Array` in the name is the invariant: immutable direct storage of whole faces.
// These types deliberately do NOT implement `IMeshElementCounts` — an unwelded
// array cannot dedupe undirected edges without building incidence, and
// `topology.concepts.plato` forbids guessing that count without building incidence.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.

// Independent triangles in space, each carrying its own three corner positions.
// IFace order is authored order; `ToTriangleMesh` welds nothing, it only supplies
// the identity index table.
type TriangleArray3D
    implements IValue, ITriangleGeometry3D
{
    Triangles: Array<Triangle3D>;
}

// Independent quadrilaterals in space, each carrying its own four corner
// positions. As with `Quad3D`, coplanarity is not guaranteed; triangulation
// splits on the A-C diagonal.
type QuadArray3D
    implements IValue, IQuadGeometry3D
{
    Quads: Array<Quad3D>;
}

//==
// # Line sets and bare point clouds
//
// IGeometry with no faces: straight segments over a shared vertex array
// (wireframes, edge overlays, sketch and hatch patterns), and unstructured
// position sets carrying no connectivity at all. Enriched clouds that add
// normals, colors, or sensor channels live in `pointclouds.types.plato`.

// Straight segments over shared vertices: wireframes
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wire-frame_model), edge overlays, debug
// lines. Each VertexPair is one independent segment, in authored direction.
type LineSet3D
    implements IValue, IIndexedSegmentGeometry3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Lines: Array<VertexPair>;
}

// Straight segments over shared vertices in the plane: sketch overlays,
// planar graphs, hatch patterns.
type LineSet2D
    implements IValue, IIndexedSegmentGeometry2D, IDeformable2D
{
    Positions: Array<Point2D>;
    Lines: Array<VertexPair>;
}

// An unstructured set of 3D positions with no connectivity
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_cloud): scan data, particle snapshots,
// sampling results. Enriched variants live in `pointclouds.types.plato`.
type PointCloud3D
    implements IValue, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
}

// An unstructured set of 2D positions with no connectivity.
type PointCloud2D
    implements IValue, IDeformable2D
{
    Positions: Array<Point2D>;
}

//==
// # Mesh partitioning
//
// Slot-tagged contiguous runs of faces: the material assignment, draw batching,
// and sub-object identity layer over a triangle mesh.

// A zero-based index into an externally owned slot table: material
// assignment, draw batching, sub-object identity. -1 means "no slot".
type SlotIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A contiguous run of faces tagged with a slot: material assignment,
// draw batching, sub-object identity. FaceRange is half-open (contains
// Start, excludes End) and indexes faces of the owning mesh.
type MeshSection
    implements IValue
{
    FaceRange: IntegerInterval;
    Slot: SlotIndex;
}
